create_TaskHook_subclass: create a custom TaskHook subclass that overrides task_hook to log input items before processing
build_TaskStatsHook_with_interval: build a TaskStatsHook instance with a 30 second interval to periodically report pipeline stage performance stats
use_stage_hooks_compose: use _stage_hooks to compose multiple TaskHook stage context managers into a single async context manager
use_task_hooks_compose: use _task_hooks to compose multiple TaskHook task context managers into a single async context manager for a given input item
set_default_hook_class: set the default hook class to None to disable hooks or to a custom TaskHook subclass for all pipeline stages
